name: aviadox-mobile
description: AviaDoX — Android (.apk) ve iOS (.ipa) Capacitor 6 projesi (arka plan GPX, kilit ekranı bildirimi, çevrimdışı mod ve GIF açılış logosu)

scripts.prepare:web: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='node_modules/@supabase/supabase-js/dist/umd/supabase.js'; if(!fs.existsSync(src)) throw new Error('Supabase UMD bulunamadi: '+src); fs.mkdirSync('www/vendor',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src,'www/vendor/supabase.umd.js'); const sz=fs.statSync('www/vendor/supabase.umd.js').size; if(sz<10000) throw new Error('Supabase UMD bos'); console.log('Supabase UMD kopyalandi -> www/vendor/supabase.umd.js ('+sz+' bayt)');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
